tolerance_rule: Per-target maximum pre-feature distance to either independent source bracket endpoint; take three times it plus 0.0021 seconds (TT/TDB bound and JD printing), rounded outward to one significant digit. These finite-data regression allowances are not API accuracy bounds or solver convergence tolerances.
clock_qualification: The independent source-clock solve holds the recorded TDB-UT1 locally constant; physical midpoint gaps retain TT/TDB<=2ms and local EOP variation/printing uncertainty. Measured clock shifts are not obtained by simply subtracting a nominal DeltaT.
